source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top parses
summary: Keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm up; nuke with Wrath or Starfire (Wrath scales better at lower gear, Starfire as spell power grows).

breakpoint.note: Wrath is the more mana-efficient and gear-light nuke; Starfire's larger hits scale up as spell power and crit grow. The mix shifts toward Starfire with better gear  -  a parse that is nearly all of one or the other is worth a second look.

advisory: Moonfire and Insect Swarm are damage-per-cast-time gains  -  letting them drop to spam a nuke is a common DPS loss.
